name: herdr-dispatch
description: Dispatch tasks through omp in isolated herdr/herdr-core worktrees; eight model presets and dispatch-omp select models while magpie owns supplier routing, with acceptance verification and pull request publishing

hooks.command: for v in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/herdr-dispatch/herdr-dispatch/*/skills; do [ -d "$v/_shared" ] || continue; for d in "$v"/dispatch-*; do [ -f "$d/SKILL.md" ] || continue; mkdir -p "$d/references" || exit 1; for f in entry routing driver plan supervise; do if [ -L "$d/references/$f.md" ]; then [ -f "$d/references/$f.md" ] || exit 1; continue; fi; cp "$v/_shared/$f.md" "$d/references/$f.md" || exit 1; done; done; done
